annotations.title: Update digest and Breaking News settings

description: Change what the account receives: digest on or off, hour (7, 12, 18 or 21 local), time zone and format (text, json or html); Breaking News on or off, threshold 0.0 to 1.0, composite (min, mean, geo or breaking) and a cap of 1 to 20 emails a day; reminder emails. Send only the fields to change; nothing is written unless all are valid. Real stories have scored min up to about 0.39 and mean higher, so 0.50 on mean is a starting point: call list_breaking first to see what a rule would have sent. Needs a token.

composite.description: How the four Jev scores combine: min (strictest), mean, geo (geometric mean) or breaking (that factor alone).

max_per_day.description: At most this many Breaking News emails in 24 hours, 1 to 20.

threshold.description: 0.0 to 1.0; an email goes when the chosen composite is at or above it.

format.description: text: plain text with key: value lines and a JSON block; json: a JSON document; html: the people's email.

tz.description: IANA time zone, for example Asia/Kolkata or Europe/London.
